name: Bracelets of Freedom
body:
Price 5,500 gp; Slot wrists; CL 3rd; Weight —; Aura faint abjuration

DESCRIPTION

These delicate arm-wrappings are made of finely spun silver and are as delicate as spider silk. They are difficult to detect even on close inspection, granting the wearer a +20 bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to hide them. The bracelets of freedom do not radiate magic when worn. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks, and once per day as a swift action he can make an Escape Artist with a +20 competence bonus as a swift action to escape from manacles (including manacles on the feet or elsewhere on the body), rope, chains, or similar restraints. If the wearer escapes the manacles, he can attempt a Sleight of Hand check with a +20 penalty to appear to inspection as if still safely restrained, though she can slip the bonds at any time thereafter as a free action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells freedom of movement
